pages.text: The Kestrel Museum signed a printing contract with Birch Printworks on 2025-07-06. Memo Q7 says the price was 93 CHF. Memo Q8, copied from Q7, repeats 93 CHF. No evidence of a donation to Hazel Society was found. The museum describes Hazel Society as a pottery society, explicitly not a criminal organization.

Correction Q9 dated 2025-07-13: Q7 misstated the price of the Kestrel Museum printing contract with Birch Printworks; the correct price is 39 CHF, not 93 CHF. The contract was terminated effective 2025-07-12. The correction does not allege fraud.
